target.title: fix: outbound recovery can replay already sent replies
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users relying on outbound delivery recovery could have an already sent reply replayed when recovery successfully sent the message but post-send bookkeeping or an adapter commit hook failed.

The affected workflow is outbound delivery recovery after a restart or failed send attempt. Once the platform send succeeds, the recovery entry must not remain as an ordinary pending retry.

## Why This Change Was Made

Recovery now marks sent replay attempts as `unknown_after_send` before acknowledging the pending queue entry, matching the live send invariant. Commit-hook failures are still isolated, but the runner returns diagnostics so recovery can persist a failed diagnostic row without requeuing the sent delivery.

## User Impact

Recovered outbound messages no longer remain pending for replay after recovery has evidence that the platform send succeeded. Operators also get a failed diagnostic row for post-send failures instead of losing the diagnostic state.

## Evidence

- `OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 pnpm test src/infra/outbound/delivery-queue.recovery.test.ts` — 24 tests passed.
- `OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 pnpm test src/infra/outbound/delivery-queue.storage.test.ts` — 12 tests passed.
- `pnpm check:test-types` — passed.
- `npx oxlint --deny=warn --ignore-path=.oxlintignore src/infra/outbound/delivery-commit-hooks.ts src/infra/outbound/delivery-queue-recovery.ts src/infra/outbound/delivery-queue-storage.ts src/infra/outbound/delivery-queue.recovery.test.ts` — passed.
- Manual recovery proof with a successful recovered send and throwing commit hook:

```text
log.info: Found 1 pending delivery entries — starting recovery
[outbound/deliver] Plugin message adapter after-commit hook failed.
log.warn: Delivery entry f460e795-72c5-4816-b3ad-94b06c906361 post-send commit hook failed: commit hook offline; recorded failed diagnostic
log.info: Recovered delivery f460e795-72c5-4816-b3ad-94b06c906361 on demo-channel-a
log.info: Delivery recovery complete: 1 recovered, 0 failed, 0 skipped (max retries), 0 deferred (backoff)
before: pending entries=1
summary: recovered=1 failed=0 skippedMaxRetries=0 deferredBackoff=0
after: pending entries=0
failed status=failed
failed recoveryState=unknown_after_send
failed lastError=post-send commit hook failed: commit hook offline
```

Known broader local validation gap:

- The broader `core-runtime-infra-state` shard was attempted with proxy variables unset and `TZ=UTC`, but the local run still failed in unrelated suites:
  - `src/infra/backup-create.test.ts`
  - `src/infra/net/fetch-guard.ssrf.test.ts`
  - `src/secrets/resolve.test.ts`
- Those failing files also failed when run individually, while the touched outbound recovery/storage tests passed.
